capabilities.answer: I can tell you about Zeenan's services, certifications, pricing approach, worldwide availability, and how to book a consultation. I can also take you straight to the appointment form, contact section, projects, or blog. Try asking something like 'what services do you offer' or 'how do I book a call'!

identity.answer: I'm Zeenan's assistant! Haa Meem Ul Karim Zeenan (goes by Zeenan) is a Digital Marketing Expert & Consultant, NSDA Level 3 certified, working with clients across Europe, America, and Asia.

services.answer: Zeenan offers SEO (search engine optimization), content strategy & writing, keyword research, and social media marketing.

seo_service.answer: Yes — SEO is one of Zeenan's core services, covering on-page optimization, technical fixes, and content structure to help a site actually rank for what people search.

content_strategy.answer: Content strategy and writing is one of Zeenan's core services — building content that targets real search intent instead of generic filler.

social_media_service.answer: Social media marketing is part of Zeenan's services — strategy and content tailored to the platform your customers actually use.

why_choose.answer: A few solid reasons to hire Zeenan: he's certified (not self-declared) with NSDA Level 3, government-recognized, plus a Grade A+ Professional Digital Marketing certificate from Creative IT Institute. His approach is data-backed, not generic advice — real keyword research and on-page SEO built on actual search intent. His process is shown openly through anonymized real client samples (bakery, real estate). He's got international experience across Europe, America, and Asia despite being based in Bangladesh, keeps client work strictly confidential, and replies within 1-2 business days.

certifications.answer: Zeenan holds an NSDA (National Skills Development Authority, Bangladesh Government) Level 3 certification in Digital Marketing for Freelancing, plus a Professional Digital Marketing certificate (Grade A+) from Creative IT Institute.

experience.answer: Zeenan is NSDA Level 3 certified in Digital Marketing and holds a Professional Digital Marketing certificate (Grade A+) from Creative IT Institute, with hands-on project experience across SEO, content, and social media.

location.answer: Zeenan is based in Bangladesh and works with clients across Europe, America, and Asia — fully remote, so location isn't a barrier.

contact.answer: You can reach Zeenan by email, on WhatsApp, or through the appointment form on this site.

appointment.answer: You can apply for an appointment right on this site — just fill in your name, WhatsApp number, email, purpose, and goal, and Zeenan will get back to you within 1-2 business days.

pricing.answer: Pricing depends on the scope of work — every project is a little different. The best way to get an accurate quote is to book a quick consultation so Zeenan can understand what you need.

seo_general.answer: SEO (Search Engine Optimization) is the practice of improving a website so it ranks higher in search results and gets found by the right people. There's a whole blog on this site with practical SEO guides if you want to dig deeper.

keyword_research.answer: Keyword research means figuring out exactly what your potential customers type into Google, so your content targets real search demand instead of guesswork.

navigate.label: the projects section for a real sample

blog.answer: There's a full blog on this site covering SEO, keyword research, and digital marketing tips — great if you want to learn the fundamentals yourself.

worldwide.answer: Yes — Zeenan works with clients across Europe, America, and Asia, not just Bangladesh. All work is done remotely, so distance isn't an issue.

response_time.answer: Zeenan typically responds within 1-2 business days after you submit the appointment form.

greeting.answer: Hey there! 👋 I'm Zeenan's assistant. Ask me about services, pricing, certifications, or say 'book' if you'd like to set up a consultation.

thanks.answer: You're very welcome! Don't hesitate to ask if anything else comes up. 🙌

portfolio_projects.answer: Client work stays confidential — Zeenan respects that fully. But there's a sample keyword research breakdown that shows the kind of process used before any content gets written.

small_business.answer: Zeenan works with businesses of all sizes, including small and local shops — practical, budget-aware marketing rather than one-size-fits-all corporate strategy.

ecommerce.answer: Yes, ecommerce SEO and content strategy fall within Zeenan's services — helping online stores get found by people actually ready to buy.

languages.answer: Zeenan communicates fluently in both English and Bangla, which is especially useful for businesses targeting Bangladeshi or South Asian audiences alongside international ones.

process.answer: It starts with a quick consultation — book through the appointment form, and Zeenan will follow up to understand your goals before proposing a plan.

testimonials.answer: Zeenan has received positive feedback from clients on professionalism, efficiency, and attention to detail. You can see a few client quotes in the 'What Clients Say' section.
